description: Adds Touhou Little Maid and MaidsoulKitchen chest type support for Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks block containers.

mods.name: Maid Sophisticated Compat
mods.description:
Unofficial compatibility patch that lets Touhou Little Maid and MaidsoulKitchen recognize Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks block containers.

非官方兼容补丁，让 Touhou Little Maid 和 MaidsoulKitchen 能识别 Sophisticated Storage 与 Sophisticated Backpacks 的方块容器。

releases.notes:
# Maid Sophisticated Compat 0.2.0

- Added the **Gap of Experience**, a new bauble.
- Maids can automatically deposit experience into or withdraw experience from compatible containers.
- Supports Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks containers equipped with tank upgrades, Create: Enchantment Industry Experience Lanterns and Experience Hatches connected to fluid tanks.

- 新增 Touhou Little Maid 女仆饰品：**经验隙间**。
- 女仆可以自动向兼容容器存入经验，或从兼容容器中取出经验。
- 支持安装储罐升级的 Sophisticated Storage 与 Sophisticated Backpacks 容器， Create: Enchantment Industry 的经验灯笼，以及连接流体储罐的经验输入槽
- 新增传输方向与女仆保留经验等级设置。
